cohort: 130 very-low-birth-weight (VLBW) infants (birth weight [BW] <1,500 g, gestational age [GA] < 32 weeks) without umbilical catheterization
finding: The 95th percentile for umbilical cord separation time in very-low-birth-weight infants was 22 days, and sepsis was found to delay cord separation.
mod_finding: Cord separation time did not differ regarding mode of delivery.
